purpose: Year-by-year, source-traceable Biology admission audit contract for DU Science and Bangladesh Medical admission tests.

source_tiers.A1: Official institution, regulator, official paper, scan, notice or syllabus
source_tiers.B1: Academic or curated dataset with explicit provenance
source_tiers.C2: Secondary answer key, coaching archive or general preparation source

invariants: Every audited question has exactly one primary_topic_id from B01-B28.
secondary_topic_ids are optional search tags and never affect primary recurrence counts.
question_fingerprint is a concise paraphrase or identifying concept, not a full copied question unless licensing permits it.
The questions array is the source of truth; topic counts are derived from question rows and are never authoritative manual inputs.

0 means a fully audited, source-backed paper/component contains no Biology questions: questions must be empty, expected_biology_question_count=0, paper_complete=true, zero_claims_allowed=true and matrix_release_allowed=false.
U means unaudited: questions must be empty, paper_complete=false, matrix_release_allowed=false and zero_claims_allowed=false.
P means partially audited: observed rows may exist, but unaudited remainder must never be converted to zero.
X means source conflict or unresolved paper identity; zero claims and matrix release remain blocked.
F-S2 means the full paper was reconstructed from secondary sources; all expected Biology opportunities must be represented, but independent verification is still pending.
F-V2 means a complete full-paper audit with independent verification; all expected Biology opportunities must be represented.
A topic-level zero is legal only after the relevant full Biology paper/component has been completely audited.
No U, P or X paper may contribute definitive zero counts or final QYI release.
For a complete paper, audited_question_count must equal expected_biology_question_count and equal questions.length.
source_refs on every question must resolve to a source_id declared in that same year file.
Final QYI remains governed by engine_v1.json release_gate, independent of any single-year audit state.
